item.title: Swift Techniques for Decoding HTML Entity Strings
item.description:
“Swift Techniques for Decoding HTML Entity Strings”

When dealing with data received from web services or stored content, strings often contain HTML character entities (like &, <, or numeric references like ‘) that need conversion back into their corresponding plain text characters (like &, <, or ‘). Since there isn’t one universally simple approach across all scenarios or Swift versions, developers have proposed several effective techniques.

How can one reliably transform an HTML-encoded string into a readable string representation in Swift, preserving or stripping HTML markup as needed?
